arguments.value: 2004 Ford F-350 4x4 Crew Cab 6.0L Diesel — repairable pickup with crew cab comfort, automatic transmission, and Power Stroke V8 turbo diesel power. Features damage to the bed, possible wiring issues, non-working speedometer display, and interior wear, with additional repairs likely needed. A solid project truck with four-wheel drive and strong potential for the right buyer.
